why: Compares the aria attributes and never reports a difference, which is the comparator as it stood before issue #937 with a loop added for show. A screen whose confirm dialog lost role="alertdialog", or whose level card lost its accessible name, would pass the required screens check while a screen reader announced something else entirely. The capture would still record the change in actual.json; nothing would ever fail to make anyone read it.
